I told Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 10 June.

- **Where that comes from:** On the 14th, Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team. The same morning they corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying they'd read the wrong line. GBrain also has the correction saved. Marcus is a member of #north-random, so the correction was already visible to them.
- **Not fully confirmed:** Ilse didn't give a year, and I can't see any Brackenwater contract in the shared files. I suggested Marcus check the year with Ilse or against the contract before putting it on the account sheet.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Marcus is on the account's team, so no approval was needed.
